All tests pass.


All 9 tests pass. Implementation in `src/version.ts:12-68`:

- **`parseVersion`** — regex-based parser supporting `v` prefix, whitespace, pre-release, and build metadata
- **`compareVersions`** — numeric comparison of major/minor/patch, then identifier-by-identifier pre-release comparison (numeric < alpha, shorter < longer), with release > pre-release
- **`sortVersions`** — non-mutating stable sort using `compareVersions`
- **`latestStable`** — filters for no pre-release, sorts, returns last element or `undefined`

`rules-loaded`
